apps.name: Cadence
apps.subtitle: Study & time manager
apps.localizedDescription: Your first-year study system: a full editable timetable (grid or list), assignments with deadline countdowns, smart "start by" planning and escalating reminders, spaced-repetition review to beat forgetting, exam tracking, and a Pomodoro focus timer with distraction tracking.

versions.localizedDescription: Recordings get smarter, automatically. After you stop: the audio is levelled and made clearer, it is transcribed with the newer on-device speech engine (punctuation, paragraphs, tap-a-timestamp to jump), and study notes are written (overview, key points, key terms, deadlines). Transcripts are never discarded. Share the audio, transcript and notes via AirDrop, Messages, Telegram, Files and more. Older recordings upgrade themselves on first open.

Class Live Activity: the progress bar now appears only once class has started and fills as the lecture goes on (it was showing before class and counting backwards). "Starts in" flips to "Ends in" on its own at class time.
Fixes the timetable grid: class blocks no longer run past their column or get cut off at the right edge (Friday was clipped), and the last class of the day now scrolls fully clear of the tab bar.

Redesigned the in-app recording screen to match Voice Memos: a live mirrored waveform that scrolls into a center playhead, a centisecond timer, and a round record button. Cleaner recording Live Activity too.

Redesigned Assignments (grouped by Overdue / This week / Upcoming / Done with a summary strip and cleaner cards) and a nicer Timetable grid (today highlighted, a live now-line, and blocks that show the course and room).

Class recording. Record a lecture (Voice-Memos style, keeps going while locked), play it back, and get an on-device transcript — find it all under the new waveform button on Today. Plus a Live Activity that shows the recording and class time left, and a fix so the class Live Activity flips from "starts in" to the in-class countdown on its own.

Reliability pass. Focus timer now keeps counting when your phone is locked and notifies you when a session ends. Reminders update when you edit a class or change something on your other device, deleted items no longer notify, and overdue assignments get a next-day nudge. Today shows which class is Now / Next / Done.
Fixes classes appearing twice in your timetable (and Today). Removes the stray repeats, and edited classes no longer duplicate across devices. Deleted classes also stay deleted.

Focus types — pick Learning, Reading, Coding, Writing, Reviewing, Problem Sets or Commute when you start the timer; it shows on the timer, in the Live Activity, and in your logs. New "Start Cadence Focus Session" Siri/Shortcuts action: build a one-time Automation to also turn on a system iOS Focus when your session starts.

Home-screen widgets (Up Next class, Today schedule, Deadlines, Recall & Focus) and Live Activities — a Pomodoro focus timer on the Lock Screen + Dynamic Island, and a current-class countdown. Widgets share data via an app group that resolves automatically even after re-signing.

Fixes duplicated courses/classes on sync; adds automatic background sync (no button needed); class-start notifications (10 min before + at start); swipe or long-press to mark an assignment Done without deleting it.
Fixes a crash when deleting items (timetable classes, assignments, etc.) on macOS/iOS 26.
